picks.title: Google’s next Gemini trick could change how you use Android XR glasses
picks.excerpt: "Hey Gemini" is coming for "Ok Google" — a new hotword and camera-activation flow for Gemini on Android XR glasses. (Published time from outlet RSS; page 403 to fetchers.)
picks.rationale: Android XR glasses get a new "Hey Gemini" hotword and a camera-activation flow. It changes how voice and camera interaction on glasses gets designed.

picks.title: Meta, Milan’s Pinacoteca di Brera, and EssilorLuxottica Expand Access to Art Through AI Glasses
picks.excerpt: Today, Meta, Pinacoteca di Brera and EssilorLuxottica are proud to launch “Sensing Art - Discovering Masterpieces Beyond What Meets the Eye.” This pilot
picks.rationale: Meta launches "Sensing Art", a pilot that uses AI glasses as an accessible museum guide at the Brera gallery. It is a new, concrete real-world use of AI glasses (the orchestrator assigned this item to gadgets).

picks.title: Samsung Expands Language Support Across AI Experiences on Galaxy
picks.excerpt: Samsung is expanding language support for Galaxy AI and Bixby, bringing these experiences
picks.rationale: Samsung officially adds languages to Galaxy AI and Bixby. That widens the markets where on-device AI features ship, and localization teams need to know about it.

picks.title: Apple says Siri doesn't need to beat ChatGPT — here's what it's betting on instead
picks.excerpt: Apple CEO John Ternus explains why Siri AI doesn't need to beat ChatGPT or Claude, and how your iPhone's personal data could give it an edge.
picks.rationale: Apple CEO John Ternus explains Siri's strategy on the record: personal context, not chatbot benchmarks. It is a first-hand statement of direction, not a repeat of the 10-12 Siri-vs-Gemini comparison.

picks.title: myFirst's AI camera and printer turn kids' ideas into instant comics
picks.excerpt: The Insta magiCam turns photos into coloring pages, stickers and illustrations, while the magiBox transforms spoken ideas into printable artwork and four-panel comics. (Published time from outlet RSS; page 403 to fetchers.)
picks.rationale: myFirst launches two kids' devices that turn photos and spoken ideas into printable illustrations and four-panel comics. It is a new product launch putting generative image AI in physical hardware.

alternates.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
alternates.excerpt: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
alternates.rationale: A Disrupt keynote that is commentary, not a release, and it overlaps the 10-16 Bee launch card. It stays an alternate.

alternates.title: Nothing reportedly launching two pairs of smart glasses, one with barely any AI
alternates.excerpt: A reliable source says that Nothing is building out its own AI smart glasses that feature ChatGPT integration, a camera,...
alternates.rationale: This is a report, not a launch, and there are already two glasses picks. It stays an alternate.
